notes: The list response contains all 112 active CPS rows at this observation time; counts may change.
Per-site subscription status is a separate GetSubscript operation. The cps CLI can retrieve the full catalog and batch statuses for an explicitly selected affiliateId.
Tracking URLs are locally constructed only after the selected affiliate site is confirmed as owner and the merchant status is APR.
The same site_url host appears for two merchant IDs; dynamic product-host matching fails closed for that ambiguous domain unless an explicit override exists.
